description: This file manages theme settings and application for a web application, including theme toggling, system preference detection, and theme change listeners.

methods.name: applyTheme
methods.description: Initializes theme application, sets event listeners for focus, blur, and system preference changes, and applies the current theme.

methods.name: addThemeListener
methods.description: Adds a listener function to be called when the theme changes.

methods.name: removeThemeListener
methods.description: Removes a previously added theme change listener.

methods.name: currentTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the current theme setting from persistent storage.

methods.name: currentDocumentTheme
methods.description: Returns the current theme applied to the document, or null if none.

methods.name: useThemeSetting
methods.description: React hook that provides the current theme and a setter function, updating the theme and document class on change.
